minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a bus operations site plan at 199 Mass Ave with six conditions, after a de minimis change.
minutes.summary: The board found and approved a de minimis stormwater permit change at 317 Sunny Hill Road, then held a public hearing on a school bus facility at the former car dealership at 199 Mass Ave, closed it and approved with conditions. It also discussed cell tower and battery storage zoning, heard committee reports, approved prior minutes, and adjourned.

decisions.decision: Six conditions for 199 Mass Ave: label snow storage and review with the conservation agent, get a DOT driveway permit and file it, dark sky lighting if the building commissioner requires it, bus repairs inside the building, hours 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., stripe parking at 60 or more buses.
Planning director will send the existing battery storage bylaw to members; they will send shortcomings to him for town counsel.
Director will tell a cell tower caller the 2018 removal was deliberate but the board is open to revisiting it, likely in about two years.
Next meetings set for December 14, January 11 and January 25; no meeting December 28.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the site plan for a school bus facility at 199 Mass Ave, the former car dealership, with six conditions after closing the public hearing.
The conditions cover snow storage, a state driveway permit, lighting, repairs done indoors, operating hours of 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., and parking striped for 60 or more buses.
The board found a stormwater permit change at 317 Sunny Hill Road to be de minimis and approved it.
Cell tower and battery storage zoning were discussed with no vote; the director will send the existing battery storage bylaw to members for comments to town counsel.
Next meetings were set for December 14, January 11 and January 25, with no meeting on December 28.

why_it_matters: The approval lets a school bus operation move into a commercial site on Mass Ave, and the conditions on hours, indoor repairs and parking size set what neighbors can expect there.
Battery storage and cell tower rules are still being drafted, so any zoning change would come later and could reach a Town Meeting vote.
